description: Ruth Kelleher has received a call from Marian Prowse about the deposit deadline. Ruth is aware that the deposit must be in Marian's account by end of Wednesday 16th September. Ruth has not yet paid the deposit herself and is waiting to see how the group will handle it.
Dev Sandhu has expressed enthusiasm for the trip twice in the thread but has not yet paid any deposit. He is aware of the deadline.
Nina Achebe has not replied to the thread about the trip. She is aware of the deposit requirement but has not communicated her decision.
Marian Prowse is holding the week for the group until end of Wednesday 16th September. She has not yet received any deposit.

Ruth sends a group message to Dev and Nina: 'Marian called – the deposit is £600 total (£200 each) and must be in her account by end of Wednesday. How do we want to handle this? I can transfer my £200 but won't cover anyone else after last year's fiasco.'
The message arrives on Dev's phone, waiting to be seen.
